profile.ja: 主人公や骸佐と遠い親戚にあたる邪眼使い。ふうま八将が一角・二車家を支える幹部であったが、現在は独立勢力を率い闇の一角を支配するギャングスターとして、主に賭場を仕切っている。彼の邪眼は“金色の丸い眼＜サイクロプス＞”と呼ばれ、金属を自在に操る能力を発揮する。邪眼を発動すると右目が金色に輝き、額にはシンボルが浮かび上がる。邪眼の力によって彼の周囲には複数のクナイが浮かび、攻撃に防御にと自在に舞い敵を翻弄する。また邪眼発動中に金属で攻撃を受けても、その金属は彼の体をすり抜けてしまう。特殊な弾丸を放つリボルバー拳銃“ゴールドパワー”を愛用している。
profile.en: He is a distant relative of Fuuma Kotaro and Nisha Gaiza, and a user of the evil eye. He was once an executive of the Fuuma Hachishin, supporting the Ichimon and Nimono families, but now he leads an independent force, ruling over a corner of the underworld as a gangster, primarily running a casino. His evil eye is called the "Golden Cyclops," and it grants him the ability to manipulate metal. When he activates his evil eye, his right eye shines gold, and a symbol appears on his forehead. The power of his evil eye causes multiple kunai to float around him, allowing him to attack and defend with ease, and even making metal attacks pass through his body. He wields a revolver called "Gold Power" that fires special bullets.

text.ja: 金崎銃兵衛だ！　センザキのギャングスターとは俺の事よ！
text.en: I'm Kanezaki Jubei! The gangster of Sensaki is me!

text.ja: おう若！　元気そうじゃねえか、結構結構！
text.en: Ah, young one! You look lively, not bad, not bad!

text.ja: ケケケ！　蛇子といい、若の周りはおもしれえ女が集まってんなあ！
text.en: Hah! Aishu Hebiko and the others, the women around you are quite something, aren't they?

text.ja: 家同士の事は色々あるみたいだけどよ、今の俺には関係ねえよ。そうだろう？
text.en: It seems like there's a lot going on between the families, but that doesn't matter to me now. Isn't that right?

text.ja: なあ若、ここにいる女……誰と誰に手を出したんだ？　いいじゃねえか、教えてくれよ
text.en: Hey, young one, the women here... who have you gotten involved with? It's fine, tell me.

text.ja: 言っておくが、俺は俺のやりたいようにやらせてもらうぜ
text.en: Let me make one thing clear: I'll do what I want, my way.

text.ja: センザキの闇で光り輝くギャングスター、それがこの俺、金崎銃兵衛だ！
text.en: I'm Kanezaki Jubei, the gangster who shines bright in the darkness of Sensaki!

text.ja: 邪眼“サイクロプス”は無敵だぜ？　誰も俺の邪魔はさせねえよ
text.en: My evil eye, "Cyclops," is invincible, right? No one's going to get in my way.
